```{r include = F}
library(vroom)
library(dplyr, quietly=T)
coloc_results <- vroom::vroom(params$coloc_results, show_col_types = F)
options(scipen=1)
```

### Volcano Plot of MR Results Against `r params$dataset` QTL Dataset

Displays all MR exposure-outcome tests: x-axis is causal effect (BETA), y-axis is −log10 FDR-adjusted p-value — points above the significance line (red dashed) and labelled are exposures with evidence of a causal relationship with the outcome GWAS.

`r sprintf("![](%s)", params$volcano_plot)`

### Statistically Significant MR results (after FDR correction)

Table of MR results that pass FDR < 0.05 and have a matching coloc result — these are the exposures with the strongest evidence of a causal effect on the outcome trait (up to top 20 shown).

Only showing top 20 results if there are more.
```{r echo=F}
mr_results <- vroom::vroom(params$mr_results, show_col_types = F) |>
  subset(p.adjusted < 0.05 & EXPOSURE %in% coloc_results$exposure) |>
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjusted) |> select(-c(id.exposure, id.outcome))

knitr::kable(head(mr_results, 20))
```

### Coloc Results

Colocalization results for each significant MR exposure — PP.H4.abf > 0.8 indicates that the MR signal and the QTL share the same causal variant, strengthening the causal inference beyond MR alone.

```{r echo=F}
coloc_results <- coloc_results |>
  dplyr::filter(exposure %in% mr_results$EXPOSURE) |>
  dplyr::arrange(desc(PP.H4.abf))
knitr::kable(coloc_results)
```

### Fine-mapping diagnostics of the GWAS

The QTL colocalization uses the GWAS's fine-mapped credible sets. Fine-mapping uses reference-panel LD unless in-sample genotypes were given, and each region is checked for inconsistency between the z-scores and the LD (`LD_MISMATCH_S`, flagged above `r ld_mismatch_s_threshold`) and for outlying variants (`N_LD_OUTLIERS`; a flipped allele is the typical cause). Credible sets with an `LD_FLAG` other than `OK` should be treated with caution; the checks matter most when more than one signal per region was fitted (L > 1).

```{r echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
fm <- finemap_diagnostics(dirname(params$finemap_complete))
print(knitr::kable(fm$summary, caption = "Fine-mapping of the GWAS"))
cs <- fm$credible_sets
if (nrow(cs) > 0 && "LD_FLAG" %in% names(cs) && any(cs$LD_FLAG != "OK")) {
  print(knitr::kable(cs[LD_FLAG != "OK", intersect(c("LOCUS", "CS", "LEAD_RSID", "LEAD_PIP", "LD_MISMATCH_S",
                                                     "N_LD_OUTLIERS_IN_CS", "LD_FLAG"), names(cs)), with = FALSE],
                     digits = 3, caption = "Flagged credible sets"))
} else {
  cat("\nNo credible set was flagged.\n")
}
```
